title: openai: /v1/chat.completions parity — params, roles, stop/logprobs, streaming & tool-call formatting
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: bring Redwood's OpenAI compatibility layer to full parity for /v1/chat.completions. This PR unifies parameter handling (max_tokens, temperature, top_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty), enforces role semantics for system/user/assistant, restores legacy stop/logprobs behavior, and fixes several streaming edge-cases that affected tool/function-calling payloads and structured output formatting. Summary of changes: single-pass params passthrough with validation and defaults, normalized role mapping and preservation of role metadata in multi-turn contexts, stop token and logprobs alignment with upstream OpenAI behavior (including partial token logging for streaming), streaming stability fixes (backpressure and fragment reassembly), and deterministic function-call JSON formatting for structured outputs. Compatibility notes: aims to be backward compatible for most customers. There is a small semantic change for callers that relied on the previous partial-role normalization (previously 'system' messages were sometimes dropped in certain internal routes); this PR preserves system messages consistently. Customers using low-level raw token hooks should review the stop/logprobs behavior change. Testing & rollout: unit+integration tests added for param passthrough and role preservation. Added e2e tests exercising streaming + function calls against the compatibility harness. Canary rollout to 10% of hosted traffic for 48 hours, with automatic rollback on quality regressions (linear ENG-4021 alerts).

c3f9b11: streaming: fix backpressure + chunk reassembly for function call payloads
d0e4a77: logging: restore stop-token/logprobs alignment with OpenAI; add partial-token logging for streaming
